items.t: Automatic transmission slips, jerks or fails
items.note: Owners report $2,300–3,500 on average. A used unit costs less.

items.t: Timing chain rattle or whine from worn guides
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Total cost is usually $1,200–2,800. Owners of 2004 vans report about $3,300.

items.t: Power sliding door stops working or will not close
items.job: Replace power sliding door cable, motor or latch
items.note: Total cost is usually $200–800.

items.t: Front subframe rusts through
items.note: Owners report about $1,700 on average.

items.t: Fuel gauge shows fuel when the tank is empty
items.job: Install fuel gauge amplifier module and harness
items.note: Free if the Nissan service campaign is still open for your van.

items.t: Center dash display and gauges go blank
items.note: Total cost is usually $200–900.

items.t: Water leaks from clogged SkyView or sunroof drains
items.job: Clear or replace roof drain hoses
items.note: Water damage to wiring or carpet adds cost.

items.t: Front wheel bearings hum or growl
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)
items.note: RepairPal lists about $426–531 per side.

items.t: Front control arms, ball joints and tie rods wear early
items.job: Replace front lower control arms and align

items.t: Alternator stops charging
Cam or crank position sensor failure
items.job: Replace camshaft or crankshaft position sensor

items.t: Worn engine mounts cause thumping
Distributor shaft bearing seizes and the engine stalls
Oil leaks from valve cover and oil pan gaskets
Power steering hose wears through and leaks
Torn CV axle boots and clicking axles
CVT jerks, hesitates or fails
items.note: Owners report about $4,500 on average.

items.t: Rear A/C leaks and stops cooling
items.job: Replace rear A/C lines and recharge
items.note: Total cost is usually $400–1,500.

items.t: Soft brake pedal from the ABS unit
items.job: ABS actuator replacement and brake fluid change
items.note: Free when done under Nissan’s campaign.
